deployment_differences: Workspace-private GPU networking; CPU clients use a token-authenticated TLS gateway tunnel.
Native Miles Tinker gateway/planner and fixed-pool SGLang router with upstream backfill-field preservation fix.
Local native checkpoint metadata and immutable exports; private HTTP transfer with SHA-256 verification and local worker cache; NFS only for background artifact mirroring.
Disable unrequested Qwen MTP loss, matching the source Lilo actor fix.
Explicit Qwen3.5 target list: upstream Tinker CLI only recognizes Qwen3 target layouts.
Tinker 0.26.2 on gateway and clients for the native Miles wire protocol.
Minimal SGLang request-carried disk backfill patch from upstream 32839114c4ada2ae237581405a8ff39dc0db9e25; kernels unchanged.
notes: Native Miles gateway/planner and fixed SGLang rollout pool, with private HTTP adapter transfer and verified local caching.
Tinker 0.26.2; the Lilo source run used 0.24.1, with matching optimizer and sampling defaults.
Default router circuit breakers retained; queue-full retries and recovery are included in timings.
One nondeterministic run per system; the GPU allocation and learning recipe match, but infrastructure paths and generated lengths differ.
The native run did not repeat the separate Lilo checkpoint roundtrip experiment.
Single nondeterministic run per system; no confidence intervals.
Steady-state statistics exclude each client's first two updates.
Step latency is publication-to-publication client time, not GPU execution time.
Equal GPU allocation: 4 H100 trainer GPUs + 8 H200 rollout GPUs.
Protocol and publication-storage differences are documented in the run manifest.
Fleet interval: earliest client pipeline start to final publication; excludes infrastructure startup and initial warmup.
GPU-hours are allocation times for that interval, not complete billed usage.
